generic_ballot.source_label: PollingForecast-compatible merged poll archive (RCP plus existing poll inputs)
generic_ballot.display_type: polling average, not an election-day forecast

external_poll.status: public context only; not included in the district forecast

generic_ballot.margin_definition: D/R two-party margin, 100 * (D share - R share) / (D share + R share). RCP uses margin_two_party_pp; existing PollingForecast rows use the PF-compatible margin field. adjusted_margin is not used.
generic_ballot.timing_rule: Include fieldwork ending on/before the report cutoff unless a verified first_public_date is after the cutoff. Unknown first-public dates remain unknown and are included with that limitation; archive_ingestion_date is never treated as first-public evidence.

House.method: House district margins and win chances use the selected weighted alpha=0.75 MoE stream. A chronological residual-KDE alignment sets its expected Democratic seats to the Trial 14 Random Forest seat-model target (trained only through 2024). The published House seat expectation and independent-race Poisson-binomial ranges are calculated from these aligned district win chances. No 2026 outcomes were used.

Senate.coverage_note: Full-chamber outlook: 35 forecast races plus 65 fixed seats (34 Democratic-caucus and 31 Republican).

Governor.coverage_note: Covers all 36 Governor races; polling and fallback composition is recorded in the source audit.

senate_seat_distribution.interpretation: Approximate Senate seat range from 35 race probabilities and 65 fixed seats; not a party-control probability.

summary.seat_range_note: Seat ranges use independent Poisson-binomial calculations from the published race probabilities; Senate includes 65 fixed seats (34 Democratic-caucus and 31 Republican).

governor_seat_distribution.interpretation: Range of Democratic wins across 36 Governor races under an independent-race assumption; this is a race-count range, not a party-control probability.

generic_ballot_forecast.target: National Democratic-minus-Republican House two-party popular-vote margin in percentage points

historical_performance.validation_explanation: House race forecasts use the selected weighted alpha=0.75 MoE stream, aligned by chronological residual KDE to the Trial 14 Random Forest expected-seat target. Trial 14 was trained only through 2024. Across the same 1,598 covered House races in 2018–2024, margin MAE is 4.536 pp, RMSE is 5.948 pp, bias is +2.579 pp, Brier score is 0.030638, log loss is 0.104989, and winner-call accuracy is 95.87%. There were 66 hard-call misses. Absolute covered-seat errors by year were 2018: 11, 2020: 11, 2022: 2, 2024: 0 (sum 24). The full-House actual is shown separately as context; covered-race metrics use only the listed validation races. These four cycles informed model selection, so these are validation results, not an untouched holdout. On the same 1,598 races, compared with the previous public stream, MAE changed by +0.515 pp, RMSE by +0.615 pp, and winner accuracy by -0.31 percentage points.
historical_performance.governor_calibration_explanation: Governor win probabilities use fixed logit sharpening k=1.5. The 2018-2024 cycles informed selection for both incumbent and challenger; the paired scorecard is validation evidence, not an independent holdout.
historical_performance.house_category_note: The Toss-up, Lean, Likely, Safe, and Overall rows use the website's existing fixed 2018–2024 validation categories so candidate comparisons use the same races. Rating thresholds remain: Toss-up below 60%, Lean 60% to below 80%, Likely 80% to below 98%, and Safe 98% or higher for the favored party. Changes are candidate minus the previous public stream on paired races; positive MAE changes are worse and positive accuracy changes are better. Macro is the unweighted mean of the four category metrics.

metadata.description: Race-level historical forecast errors from the same chronological validation streams used in the public performance section.
metadata.error_source: The published House, Senate, and Governor validation forecast rows, using the best currently selected website forecast stream for each office.
metadata.error_definition: Signed error is predicted Democratic-minus-Republican margin minus actual Democratic-minus-Republican margin. Positive means the forecast was too Democratic; negative means it was too Republican.
metadata.summary_aggregation: For a current race label, pool only its eligible 2018–2024 validation rows; the summary MAE uses those same row errors.
metadata.source_note: Each displayed forecast-error row identifies its forecast stream and prediction source. House validation margins and win chances use the selected weighted alpha=0.75 MoE chronological OOT stream with residual-KDE alignment; the 2018 probability fallback uses only earlier training information. The current 2026 House display stream is aligned to the Trial 14 Random Forest expected-seat target, trained only through 2024. Senate uses the significant Optuna-tuned poll-residual ranker with selected-stack fallback and RF alignment, followed by its separately refit prior-only probability calibration. Governor applies the fixed pre-2018 House-gap Ridge correction to direct polls where covered and retains the significant Optuna-tuned fundamentals-plus-generic fallback otherwise; probabilities use Governor's own sequential prior-only calibration.
metadata.chronology_note: Website prior-error calculations include only 2018, 2020, 2022, and 2024 evaluation rows. Every included row has training_latest_cycle earlier than its evaluation year.
metadata.selection_note: Office streams were selected using the established 2018–2024 validation panel. These historical rows are chronological out-of-time predictions, but the selected stream is not an untouched post-selection test.
metadata.current_stream_note: The current 2026-10-23 House snapshot uses the selected weighted alpha=0.75 MoE district margins and win chances, aligned by chronological residual KDE to the Trial 14 Random Forest expected-seat target (trained only through 2024). The 435 aligned district probabilities determine the published expected seats and independent-race Poisson-binomial range; no 2026 outcomes were used. House validation metrics and category breakdowns are in historical_performance and use the established 2018–2024 panel. Senate margins/calls remain on their selected office-specific stream. Senate display probabilities add a Senate-only prior-trained temperature calibrated on Senate OOT predictions through 2024; a prediction-only intercept preserves the selected RF-aligned expected seat total. Governor applies the House-gap Ridge residual model refit through 2024 to its separate direct poll average where covered and retains its fundamentals-plus-generic fallback where uncovered; its probabilities use a prior-only slope refit on the corrected OOT margins, with no Senate calibration or RF seat alignment. The cached Governor poll snapshot is dated 10/19 and covers 33 of 36 races. Governor prior-error history uses only the 2018–2024 validation panel.

race_page_current_poll_source.timing_rule: Include poll measurements whose fieldwork ends on or before 2026-10-21, unless a verified first_public_date is later than the cutoff. Unknown first-public dates remain unknown and are included; archive ingestion is never treated as first-public evidence. These inputs do not establish that every included poll was publicly available by the cutoff.

CA-34.history_note: This district had no eligible two-party historical target; displayed errors are California peer averages, not CA-34 results.
